title: After-Halloween with Duo Laroo/Byrd
description: An afternoon pop-up concert the Sunday after Halloween. Saskia Laroo (trumpet, saxophone, bass, vocals) and Warren Byrd (keys, vocals, bongos) play original jazz, funk, soul and spontaneous improvisation, during the group exhibition Alone Together. Presented by Paulien Lethen. Suggested donation $10.
imageAlt: Duo Laroo/Byrd at Holland Tunnel Revisited, Nov 1, 2026: Warren Byrd at the grand piano and Saskia Laroo on saxophone, with framed works on the gallery walls
